key_facts: July 14 FINAL-DAY update (T+1d to Wednesday July 15 Stage 11 Vichy-Nevers 161.3km flat sprint; SUBMITTED major update raising Tim Merlier 0.31->0.51 and adding Max Kanter over Mads Pedersen): (1) Stage 10 survival confirmed: Tadej Pogacar won mountainous Stage 10 at Le Lioran; Eurosport.de confirms Merlier finished comfortably inside time limit and all top sprinters survived EXCEPT Soren Waerenskjold (Uno-X) who crashed on Stage 10. (2) Live July 14 post-Stage 10 bet365 odds (Racing Post) show Tim Merlier as an odds-on 4-7 favorite (raw 63.6%, Shin devig 0.537, power devig 0.577) ahead of Olav Kooij 7-2 (Shin 0.179), Biniam Girmay 7-1 (Shin 0.095), Jasper Philipsen 10-1 (Shin 0.066), Max Kanter 16-1 (Shin 0.039), Soren Waerenskjold 25-1 (Shin 0.022). (3) Course & tactics (IDL Pro Cycling, WielerFlits, SpazioCiclismo, TodayCycling): easiest flat stage of Tour (only two Cat-4 bumps, ~30C slightly cooler than 40C heatwave, light tailwind, very low breakaway chance), but technical finale has chicane <1km and 500m roundabout narrowing single-file right. Merlier won Stages 7 & 8 cleanly (even w/ Stuyven replacing abandoned Van Lerberghe) and desperately needs points to close 80-pt green jersey deficit to Pedersen (293 vs 213). Pedersen explicitly riding damage control for ~5th place (dropped from top-5 in favor of 16-1 Max Kanter). Slightly tempered Merlier from Shin 0.537 -> 0.51 for 500m roundabout sprint chaos and bumped Philipsen gently 0.066 -> 0.08 for MVDP full lead-out + cooler temps: Merlier 0.51 (+0.20), Kooij 0.17 (+0.01), Girmay 0.09 (-0.02), Philipsen 0.08 (-0.05), Kanter 0.04 (NEW); sum=0.89 (11% field).
